titles.native: 悪魔のメムメムちゃん

description:
The "only slightly erotic comedy" anime centers on the titular Memumemu-chan, a succubus who isn't lewd, isn't erotic, and doesn't try hard. The anime follows her struggle to harvest souls.

(Source: Anime News Network)
